evidenceFlow.title: Deterministic generator
evidenceFlow.detail: Python random seed 271828; 1,800 fictional customers and 2,800 application records; no ICICI data. Run python3 analysis/generate_demo.py.

caveats: Independent portfolio project; not affiliated with ICICI Bank. Values and correlations are deliberately simulated.
Loans are application cohorts for FY2025–26, with balances and payment totals as at 31 March 2026. No opening loan book is supplied.
90+ DPD exposure is an analytical delinquency indicator, not an official regulatory NPA measure.
Product ownership is a single customer snapshot, not purchase-event transactions; association does not establish causality or suitability.

metricDefinitions.label: Approval rate
metricDefinitions.definition: Approved, Active, Closed, and Written off application count / all applications, including Pending.

metricDefinitions.label: Disbursements
metricDefinitions.definition: Sum of disbursedAmount for funded applications in the selected application cohort; monthly trend is bucketed by application month, not cash-flow month. Units: INR.

metricDefinitions.label: 90+ DPD exposure
metricDefinitions.definition: Active outstanding balance with daysPastDue >= 90 / all active outstanding balance.

metricDefinitions.label: Collection ratio
metricDefinitions.definition: Sum of cumulative receivedPayment / sum of cumulative scheduledPayment, to the snapshot date, for funded loans in the selected application cohort. Not monthly cash flow.

metricDefinitions.label: Support
metricDefinitions.definition: Customer baskets containing antecedent AND consequent / all scoped customer baskets, including empty baskets.

metricDefinitions.label: Confidence
metricDefinitions.definition: Customer baskets containing antecedent AND consequent / baskets containing antecedent.

metricDefinitions.label: Lift
metricDefinitions.definition: Confidence / consequent ownership prevalence. >1 indicates positive association in this sample.

metricDefinitions.label: Potential customers
metricDefinitions.definition: Customers holding every antecedent product and not holding the consequent; not validated leads or credit eligibility.

evidenceFlow.title: Deterministic generator
evidenceFlow.detail: Python random seed 271828; 1,800 fictional customers and 2,800 application records; no ICICI data. Run python3 analysis/generate_demo.py.

caveats: Independent portfolio project; not affiliated with ICICI Bank. Values and correlations are deliberately simulated.
Loans are application cohorts for FY2025–26, with balances and payment totals as at 31 March 2026. No opening loan book is supplied.
90+ DPD exposure is an analytical delinquency indicator, not an official regulatory NPA measure.
Product ownership is a single customer snapshot, not purchase-event transactions; association does not establish causality or suitability.

metricDefinitions.label: Approval rate
metricDefinitions.definition: Approved, Active, Closed, and Written off application count / all applications, including Pending.

metricDefinitions.label: Disbursements
metricDefinitions.definition: Sum of disbursedAmount for funded applications in the selected application cohort; monthly trend is bucketed by application month, not cash-flow month. Units: INR.

metricDefinitions.label: 90+ DPD exposure
metricDefinitions.definition: Active outstanding balance with daysPastDue >= 90 / all active outstanding balance.

metricDefinitions.label: Collection ratio
metricDefinitions.definition: Sum of cumulative receivedPayment / sum of cumulative scheduledPayment, to the snapshot date, for funded loans in the selected application cohort. Not monthly cash flow.

metricDefinitions.label: Support
metricDefinitions.definition: Customer baskets containing antecedent AND consequent / all scoped customer baskets, including empty baskets.

metricDefinitions.label: Confidence
metricDefinitions.definition: Customer baskets containing antecedent AND consequent / baskets containing antecedent.

metricDefinitions.label: Lift
metricDefinitions.definition: Confidence / consequent ownership prevalence. >1 indicates positive association in this sample.

metricDefinitions.label: Potential customers
metricDefinitions.definition: Customers holding every antecedent product and not holding the consequent; not validated leads or credit eligibility.
